content: Adzahadzaha Lii Maamaala
Farisiyaha ar dǝ kyalma lii tsaga adzahadzaha Musa lii saral ma Wurshalima faɗarvǝt vak Yesu.
Kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ kyalǝma mbǝrzahaan ar zaa kaf kwal barga dǝva, tǝdvad adzahadzahaatǝra ar maay dǝ caccu biya.
Aɗaba Farisiyaha ard Yahudaha baɗǝm ar maay za kaf ǝndkwah biya, bamma bararabarǝg kǝ dǝvahaatǝra, tǝdvad adzahadzaha daadijahaatǝra.

Ma saraghasǝg saa ma kasukwa, ar maay za kaf ndan biya bamma bararabarga. Mǝng dlaɓ watlǝrǝn kǝ adzahadzaha daadijah baɗyak kwa gwiyaru nǝ iitǝra, dlaɓa ar tsuufǝgaana, band bara kuwa hǝɓɓa yuwa, shakaha, ar dǝ tǝfuwa.
Kaa ndavgarundavǝg kǝ Farisiyaha ar dǝ lii tsaga adzahadzaha Musa kǝ Yesu, “Aujilbǝg kǝ mbǝrzahagh ar maay gata adzahadzaha daadijah ar za kaf dǝ dǝv bakwal caccuwi?”
Ngwatǝrangug taakiya, “Mbats ba kalkal nǝ tlayanngǝra tagga nǝ Ishay tǝghǝr kǝskuram taakiya am muniya! Bandkwa vindava taakiya,

content.text: “Am Daadamazhigǝla, ‘Ar fǝkwaara bad ghai nǝ uudah kǝskaiya,
Ar ɓagwa ba gyagyaan kǝ kwatnahǝra.

content: “Ɗuwamarsɗuug nǝ uuram kǝ adzahadzaha Daadamazhigǝl kwa tagaa nǝ iin taaki aa gatavgatǝga am gata dǝga daadiij uudaha.”
Amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, “Am sǝrgasǝrg kǝ ɗuwa adzahadzaha Daadamazhigǝla mbakyarvad am gata dǝga daadijaharuwa!
Aɗaba tagaatag Musa taakiya, ‘Faarafǝg kǝ daadagha ar dǝ baabagha,’ dlaɓa, ‘Dadda kwa ɗaava daddana bi babbaana barari tsavva.’
Am ɗuugarsɗuug nǝ uuram kǝ uudi maay tsa puuta daddaana ar dǝ babbaan biya, farwut taakiya baɗǝm nǝ dǝgit mamma ndza da tlǝkkǝna nǝ uuram vakara fanarafǝg kǝ Daadamazhigǝla.
Tsamarva ndǝkwah nǝ uuram kǝ mǝlgaru kǝ daddana ard babbaana.
Tǝdvad kwan wam neneg nǝ uuram kǝ ǝlbǝga Daadamazhigǝl mbakyarvad dǝga daadijahi am tsagtǝr nǝ uuram kǝ uudaha. Am ɓag band kwah dlaɓ nǝ uuram kǝ dǝgitah baɗyaka.”
Dǝgiti Fǝgara Uud ndzǝga kwal Caccu Tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝla
Kaa gwiya ɗahtǝrǝtɗahǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ dlamakǝlaaa, amaa taa kǝ iitǝra, “Cinngamwacinng baɗǝmma, am nǝghaaka dlaɓ ba marauwa.
Dǝgiti dǝgaa damma vǝgh kǝ uud bi wa fǝgara ndzǝga kwal caccu tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝl biya, dǝgiti sagal ma vǝgh kǝ uud wa fǝgaraa ndzǝga kwal caccu tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝla.” [
Daddakwad hyimiya cinngaana aa cinngacinnga.]
Tǝhala tagwavaan dǝ uudaha, kaa daas kǝ iin da hǝnyaha, kaa ndavgarundavǝg kǝ mbǝrzahaan kǝ dǝgiti tuuk vakai nǝ wanǝn kǝ garava.
Ngwatǝrangugga amaa, “Mbats kuram ndakwi nǝghamaaka biya? Nǝghamaaka bi taakiya Dǝgiti dǝgaa damma vǝgh kǝ uud bi wa fǝgaraa ndzǝga kwal caccu tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝl biya,
aɗaba aa dǝhi damma rǝviɗyan biya, aa dǝhi ba damma huɗaana, tǝhalakwaha kaa sagal ma vǝghaana.” (Vaakwana maradamarǝg Yesu taakiya makwar kǝ dǝgzǝga bad caccuwa.)
Kaa zavuukw dǝ taakiya, “Dǝgiti sagal ma vǝgh kǝ uud iin wa fǝgaraa uud ndza kwal caccuwa
Kwakyarvad sagal ma rǝviɗmahuɗa uud nǝ dzama ɓa kǝladǝra, shiɓǝlga, ɓa gǝla, tsa shifǝgga ar dǝ ɓa gwaragwara,
ard dlǝrmǝga, kǝlaadǝra, valla uudaha, ar dǝ kǝmma dǝga tsa zhǝrwa, ar dǝ shilga, ar dǝ badza ɗaaga, ar dǝ naaghǝra ar dǝ dlagǝra
Baɗǝm wanahaan kǝ dǝga kǝlaadǝra sagal bamma rǝviɗmahuɗuuda, badzǝgaan kǝ ndzǝgana uuda.”
Fadghǝra uussa
Kaa ciya dagal kǝ Yesu vaakwahiin damma larda Taya ard Sidon. Kaa daas kǝ iin da vǝgya uudana, nahabi nǝ iin maa sǝran aanji ndǝwar biya. Bakǝvakwaha pǝlewapǝlǝg kǝ shǝɓga.
Cinngha ba nǝ uusiin kwa tsaag shiɗkwa shatanaha kǝ zǝr dǝghwaan kǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝra, caaricaari kaa dagau mbǝɗan tǝvuukwana.
Uusna dǝghwa Helenaha. Yavva ma larda Finikiya ma haiya Suriya. Kaa ghalla Yesu kǝ iin maa lagwda kǝ shatanahǝn ma vǝgha dǝghwaana.
Am Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Aazaruuzǝg zarh ndan tlǝtǝra, kalkalbi kǝsvant kaf vǝlǝvtǝr kǝ ghǝgyah biya.”
Ngwangug nǝ uusǝna amaa, “Aana, bandkwah, dadda tsaga dǝgita, abi, zǝgaan nǝ ghǝgyah kǝ kafi ɓalgal vaka zǝgaa kǝ zarǝh.”
Aiyam Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Mbakyarvad ngwuggi aghaa ngugga nǝngna, dǝg daas da hǝnyaha, ɗuugharɗuug shatanahiin kǝ dǝghwagha.”
Kaa gwiya daas kǝ iin da hǝnyaha, tlǝghara hǝnga tǝ piin kǝ dǝghwaana, ɗuugharsɗuug shatanaha.
Mbǝghnambǝg Yesu kǝ matanga kwa tagdabi kǝ ghaiya
Ɗuughars ba nǝ Yesu kǝ larda Taya, kaa ghuda dagal dǝ Sidon lakutti gwiya daas damma yiwahaiya Galili, ar dǝ ghaiya kǝs kǝlawa Dikapolis.
Vaakwaha ar sardǝv nǝ uudah kǝ matangng kwa tagǝda dlah kǝ ghaiya. Kaa ghalgaan kǝ iitǝr maa tappǝna kǝ uudanǝn maa mbanna.
Ɗahant kǝ iin kǝ matangǝn damma dlǝmmbaava vakavaki maay ndwar biya, kaa fahardǝm kǝ iin kǝ zarha dǝvaan damma hyemyahaana, dlaɓa tǝfa kǝ ashavaiya, tapǝna kǝ aryahaana da ashavayiina.
Kaa vazza damma zhigǝl kǝ Yesu kaa ɗǝya shifǝg kǝ iin bad ndzǝɗa, amaa taa kǝ iina, “Iffata!” Iin taakiya, “Wurga!”
Tagaa ba nǝ iin kwaha, kaa wurǝg kǝ hyimiyahaana, dǝgiti hǝkyǝghani aryahaana plǝmpǝlga, kaa tagaan kǝ iin kǝ ghai ba marawwa.
Ɓǝlatǝraaɓǝlǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ maggi aa tagarar bi aanji war biya, bakǝvakwaha kaa kutgaan kǝ iitǝr kǝ dǝgiti dzǝghardzǝgǝn.
Kaa ɓa jappǝr kǝ uudah ba vaivaiya, am nǝ iitǝra, “Ɓagaaɓag kǝ dǝgit baɗǝm bakalkala! Baz lii matang ndza cinngacinng kǝ ǝlbǝga, lii hatstǝruu hyǝmiya ar tagaan kǝ ghaiya.”
